description: The 10 busiest identities across the top, and the 25 index families they read most down the side; a more solid cell is more requests, on a log scale. A data stream and its backing indices are one family, as is a run of dated daily indices; wildcard and date-math expressions are left out. A blank cell means that identity did not touch that family in range — or touched it too little to be among the 500 busiest identity/family pairs. A request naming several indices counts once per index. An identity that reads as an opaque id is a principal whose events carry no email and no key name — usually an organisation-level Elastic Cloud API key, which the audit stream records only by its id.

text.expr: length(data('rows')) ? '' : 'No activity for this selection in this time range'

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE LOCATE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices, "*") == 0 AND NOT attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE "<*" | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | EVAL idx = REPLACE(REPLACE(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^\.ds-""", ""), """[-.]?\d{4}[.-]\d{2}[.-]\d{2}(-\d+)?$""", "") | STATS events = SUM(n) BY actor, idx | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 500
